content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification:** missing (fallback-level insert).

**What I found.** Paragraph 18 ("Duration of Agreement and Realization of Assets") and Subparagraph 23.3 address only the asset side of exit — a reasonable agreement to be negotiated so a departing Terminal Party's station keeps operating (p0231, p0257), assumption of the departing Party's interests and obligations (p0232), decommissioning/liquidation (p0234), and residual third-party liabilities (p0235, p0280). Records retention (p0166, five years) and surviving confidentiality (p0274, five years) do not supply an exit mechanic. There is no transition/migration assistance obligation, no defined transition period, and no data return or export obligation, so every fallback element fails.

**Cure.** A single new Subparagraph 18.8 inserted after 18.7, at the fallback level only: on expiry or termination (including of our participation), the other Parties provide at least 90 days' transition assistance on request and export and deliver our data and records within 30 days. I deliberately did not volunteer the preferred six-month/then-current-rates/certified-deletion package, drafted the data element to reach all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for us, and made the clause run in our favour only so it creates no new obligation on Teleglobe.
